theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_transEst_abs_setIntegral_fderiv_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (R C : ℝ), (∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) (R + 1) → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g y ≤ C) → ∀ ψ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → (∀ y, |ψ y| ≤ 1) → ∀ a h : Rn N, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → |∫ z in F, fderiv ℝ ψ (z - a) h| ≤ C * ‖h‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
